conventions: times UTC; directions coming FROM (deg); heights m; periods s; see feeds.py docstring

exact.what: Stage A (pieces/06-live-wave/stage_a.py) run for each listed hour; break_s = metres along the 49 profiles (offsets -600..600 m every 25 m, line 236 deg, along 326 deg from the house), packed as 98 characters: two base-36 digits of s/2 per profile, '--' = no break on that profile

tide.source: Open-Meteo sea_level_height_msl for every model (Copernicus wave products carry no sea level)

point.note: model grid cell the API snapped to

models.period_rule: primary swell partition (Open-Meteo swell_wave_*, Copernicus *_SW1); period rule in stage_a_period()
primary swell partition (Open-Meteo swell_wave_*, Copernicus *_SW1); period rule in stage_a_period()
